sources.title: Decree No. 289/2020: visa-free regime for Bahraini citizens
sources.publisher: Office of the President of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: Ukraine's President publishes this operative decree on the official president.gov.ua domain; it names the Kingdom of Bahrain, its start date, and the stay limit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Establish from 1 August 2020 a visa-free regime ... for citizens of ... the Kingdom of Bahrain.

sources.title: Visas to Jordan

sources.supportingExcerpt: Bahrain | Applicable | Visa can be obtained upon arrival.

policies.title: Bahraini ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Ukraine's operative presidential decree grants Bahraini citizens visa-free entry and transit for stays of up to 90 days in 180 days.
conditions: The waiver covers entry and transit for Bahraini citizens for no more than 90 days in any 180-day period.
It establishes the ordinary-passport short-visitor baseline, not work, residence, special travel documents, wartime operational access, or final admission.

policies.title: Bahraini ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table expressly identifies Bahrain as eligible to obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: The table identifies Bahrain as arrival-visa applicable without stating a fee.
Jordan's table also requires non-Jordanians to obtain a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure.
Work, residence, special travel documents, entry-point limits, carrier checks and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Bahraini ordinary passports: Mongolia advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Mongolia's current official schedules limit the Bahrain waiver to diplomatic passports, omit Bahrain from the eVisa cohort, and direct other nationals to an embassy visa application.
conditions: Mongolia's live exemption schedule lists Bahrain only for diplomatic passports, not ordinary passports.
Bahrain is not in the Immigration Agency's current eVisa-eligible-country list; the Foreign Ministry directs other foreign nationals to submit an application at a Mongolian embassy.
This is an advance visitor-visa baseline, not a finding about work, residence, transit, diplomatic, special or service documents.

application.label: Mongolian diplomatic-mission visa application guidance
application.processingTime: The page says normal processing is three working days, with some applications taking five to ten working days.
steps: Apply at the nearest Mongolian diplomatic mission because the ordinary Bahraini passport is not in the listed exemption or eVisa cohorts.
Submit the ordinary tourist-visa requirements published by the competent Mongolian mission before travel.

policies.title: Bahraini ordinary passports: North Macedonia advance visitor visa
policies.summary: North Macedonia's live Foreign Ministry checker returns that Bahraini foreign citizens need a visa, and its procedure requires a visa before entry.
conditions: The Foreign Ministry's nationality checker returns 'Needed' for Bahrain.
Separate third-country-document entry waivers, if applicable, are not an ordinary Bahraini-passport baseline.
Work, residence, transit, special travel documents and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: North Macedonia visa application procedure
steps: Apply through the competent North Macedonian diplomatic-consular representation before the intended trip.
Submit the application no more than six months and at least 15 days before travel.

policies.title: Bahraini ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule expressly requires Bahraini visitors to obtain a visa prior to arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bahraini passport holder travelling to Grenada as a short visitor.
The current schedule marks Bahrain 'Prior to Arrival'; it does not establish an electronic or border-issued route.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier checks and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Bahraini ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly places Bahrain in the authorized-visa cohort, requiring advance consular approval unless its separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bahraini passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Submit the authorized-visa application and listed documents before travel; the Embassy says approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, consular-jurisdiction requirements and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on document verification and completion.
steps: Determine that Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Submit the listed authorized-visa documents to the competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
Travel only after the consular visa has been granted and carry all required supporting documents.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback treats Bahraini passports as visa-free, while Jordan's live official nationality table says the visitor visa is obtained upon arrival.
Vanuatu Immigration's live nationality page lists Bahrain under both countries not requiring and countries requiring a visitor visa, so it cannot support one normalized status.
